web.title: 1000 Crore Club
web.description:
_Baahubali 2_ was followed by _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal_(2016_film))_, which is the [highest-grossing Indian film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_Indian_films) globally till date, which grossed over ₹2,000 crore (US$307.12 million). ## History _Baahubali 2_ is the highest-grossing film in [India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India) till date, where it has grossed ₹1,429 crore (US$219.44 million). _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal_(2016_film))_ (2016), following its Chinese release on 5 May 2017,[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1000_Crore_Club#cite_note-bbc1-23) became the [highest-grossing Indian film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_Indian_films) of all time and fifth highest-grossing non- [English language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_language) film of that time, crossing ₹2,000 crore ($307.12 million) worldwide, making it the first Indian film to gross $300 million worldwide and one of the top 30 highest-grossing [2016 films](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2016_in_film) (surpassing the $299.5 million gross of _[Alice Through the Looking Glass](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alice_Through_the_Looking_Glass_(2016_film))_). ## List ### Worldwide | No. | Title | [Worldwide gross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_highest-grossing_Indian_films) | Year | Language | Rating | Ref | |-|-|-|-|-|-|-| | 1 | _[Dangal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dangal_(2016_film))_ |
